title: robustDIF Technical Notes
text: robust DIF estimator θ̃\tilde\theta can computed using IRLS based weighted mean definition given . IRLS algorithm follows: Initialize θ(0)\theta^{(0)} set iteration counter t=0t = 0. Compute standardized residuals ui(t)=(Yi−θ(t))/siu_i^{(t)} = (Y_i - \theta^{(t)}) / s_i. Compute weights wi(θ(t))=ψ(ui(t))/ui(t)w_i(\theta^{(t)}) = \psi(u_i^{(t)}) / u_i^{(t)} wi*(0)≡1w^*_i(0) \equiv 1. Update θ(t+1)=∑=1mwi(θ(t))Yi\theta^{(t+1)} = \sum_{= 1}^{m} w_i(\theta^{(t)})\, Y_i wi(θ(t))=wi*(θ(t))/si2∑j=1mwj*(θ(t))/sj2w_i(\theta^{(t)}) = \frac{w^*_i(\theta^{(t)}) / s_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^{m} w^*_j(\theta^{(t)}) / s_j^2}. |θ(t+1)−θ(t)|<ϵ|\theta^{(t+1)} - \theta^{(t)}| < \epsilon stop; else set t=t+1t = t + 1 return step 2. algorithm converged, set θ̃=θ(t+1)\tilde\theta = \theta^{(t+1)}. Item-level DIF tests can conducted using Wald test statistic given multi-parameter variant given Halpin (2022).
